title: Project foundation
summary: Repository scaffold, build, CI skeleton and engineering conventions.
exitCriteria: Solution builds and tests run in CI on every push.

title: Graph kernel and conformance suite
summary: Language-neutral typed graph, snapshots, traversal, safety policies, explanation paths, driven by synthetic acceptance tests written first.
exitCriteria: All language-neutral selection, versioning, deletion, uncertainty and determinism scenarios pass.

title: Two independent language ecosystems
summary: Plugin protocol plus C#/.NET and Python/pytest analyzers and runners using the identical core planner.
exitCriteria: Both ecosystems use the same core planning engine on real repositories with reproducible selected test execution.

title: CI shadow-mode validation
summary: Run full suites beside planned subsets, replay historical changes, inject mutations and measure miss rate and savings.
exitCriteria: Empirical missed-regression and wall-clock metrics meet an explicit rollout threshold across representative projects.

title: Cross-language impact and optimized CI
summary: TypeScript analysis, contract propagation, per-test runtime evidence and enforced conservative selection.
exitCriteria: Contract changes select appropriate tests in other languages and CI safely enforces the computed plan.

title: Change-impact verification platform
summary: Extend the graph to prompts, model configs, MCP tools, workflows and evaluation datasets. Starts only after E1-E4 validation.
exitCriteria: Agent evaluations are selected by changes to prompts, tools, schemas and workflows.
